nodes.summary: A function $f \colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ is approximately continuous at $x$ if, for every $\varepsilon > 0$, the set $S_\varepsilon = \{y : |f(y) - f(x)| < \varepsilon\}$ has density $1$ at $x$: the Lebesgue outer measure of $S_\varepsilon \cap (x - \delta, x + \delta)$, divided by $2\delta$, tends to $1$ as $\delta \to 0^+$.
nodes.title: Approximate continuity

nodes.summary: The upper right-hand approximate derivative of $f \colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ at $x$ is positive: there are $a > 0$ and $\varepsilon > 0$ such that for every $\delta > 0$ there is $\delta' \in (0, \delta]$ for which the Lebesgue outer measure of $\{h \in (0, \delta'] : (f(x + h) - f(x))/h > a\}$ is at least $\varepsilon \delta'$.
nodes.title: Positive upper right approximate derivative

nodes.summary: A set $S \subseteq \mathbb{R}$ has right-hand density $0$ at $0$ if the Lebesgue outer measure of $S \cap (0, \delta]$, divided by $\delta$, tends to $0$ as $\delta \to 0^+$.
nodes.title: Right density zero at the origin

nodes.summary: Let $f \colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathbb{R}$ be approximately continuous at every point, and suppose that at every point $x$ the upper right-hand approximate derivative of $f$ is positive. Then $f$ is monotone nondecreasing.
nodes.title: Approximate derivative test for monotonicity (Scottish Book Problem 157)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
